span.p:
Input Data:
Human scores (>= 2 per item) & LLM scores

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 1:
Compute Human-Human disagreements
All pairwise abs(h_i - h_j) per item

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2:
Compute LLM-Human disagreements
All abs(h_i - llm) per item

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 3:
Establish Random Baseline
Uniform random scores (min..max)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 4:
Statistical test (MWU, one-sided)
Compare LLM-Human vs Human-Human
H1: LLM-Human > Human-Human

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LLM is 'Good Enough'
No evidence it diverges
more than humans do

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LLM is NOT 'Good Enough'
Diverges more than humans
(statistically significant)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sanity check (optional):
MWU test Random-Human vs Human-Human
Expect p < 0.05 with enough data
